parts.zh: 你有没有注意到你和朋友有多相似?这可能是因为你们的大脑彼此协调运作
加利福尼亚大学的研究人员扫描了42名同学的大脑
W: 我下周六不在这儿
W: 对。我小侄子要过六岁生日了
M: 哦,好吧。我从小时候起就没去过动物园了
W: 动物园远不像我们小时候那么受欢迎了
M: 你知道 Dan 下周六有空吗?
W: 嗯,我觉得他应该有空

items.stem: What may be the reason that friends are similar to each other according to the recent research?

choices.text: Their brains work in harmony.
choices.zh: 他们的大脑协调运作。

choices.text: They are generally the same age.
choices.zh: 他们通常年龄相同。

choices.text: Their interests are quite similar.
choices.zh: 他们的兴趣非常相似。

choices.text: They have the same ethnic background.
choices.zh: 他们有相同的族裔背景。

items.stem: What does the news report say about the relationship between friends?

choices.text: It can be touching.
choices.zh: 它可能令人感动。

choices.text: It is hard to predict.
choices.zh: 它难以预测。

choices.text: It can work both ways.
choices.zh: 它可以双向作用。

choices.text: It resembles family ties.
choices.zh: 它类似于家庭纽带。

items.stem: What did both Alan Robinson and Walter MacDonald attempt to do on DNA matching websites?

choices.text: Search for their half-brothers.
choices.zh: 寻找他们同父异母的兄弟。

choices.text: Identify their biological fathers.
choices.zh: 确认他们的生父身份。

choices.text: Find out more about their ancestry.
choices.zh: 了解更多关于他们祖先的信息。

choices.text: See whether they are actually related.
choices.zh: 查看他们是否真的有血缘关系。

items.stem: What did the news report say about Alan Robinson and Walter MacDonald?

choices.text: They were both given up for adoption.
choices.zh: 他们都被送去领养了。

choices.text: They were born to the same mother.
choices.zh: 他们是同一个母亲所生。

choices.text: They flew 737 airplanes as pilots.
choices.zh: 他们作为飞行员驾驶 737 飞机。

choices.text: They were both 60 years of age.
choices.zh: 他们都是 60 岁。

items.stem: Why did one of the male tourists feel sad?

choices.text: One of his friends was caught littering.
choices.zh: 他的一位朋友因乱扔垃圾被抓到。

choices.text: Other tourists refused to join in the cleanup.
choices.zh: 其他游客拒绝参加清理活动。

choices.text: The beautiful beach was spoiled with lots of trash.
choices.zh: 美丽的海滩被大量垃圾破坏了。

choices.text: The kilometer-long beach was practically deserted.
choices.zh: 这片长达一公里的海滩几乎荒无一人。

items.stem: Who put the good deed video on the internet?

choices.text: A passerby.
choices.zh: 一位路人。

choices.text: A local woman.
choices.zh: 一位当地妇女。

choices.text: The beach authorities.
choices.zh: 海滩管理部门。

choices.text: One of the five tourists.
choices.zh: 五位游客中的一位。

items.stem: Why did one local woman say she was embarrassed?

choices.text: The tourists' good deed was not noticed by the locals.
choices.zh: 游客的善举没有被当地人注意到。

choices.text: Some natives were selling poor-quality food to tourists.
choices.zh: 一些本地人向游客出售劣质食品。

choices.text: The number of tourists to the beach is on a steady decline.
choices.zh: 前往海滩的游客数量持续下降。

choices.text: It was tourists not natives who were cleaning up the beach.
choices.zh: 清理海滩的是游客而不是本地人。

items.stem: Why can't the man go for a run Saturday morning?

choices.text: He has to play football with workmates.
choices.zh: 他必须和同事踢足球。

choices.text: He has got some books to read.
choices.zh: 他有一些书要读。

choices.text: He is going to visit a friend.
choices.zh: 他要去拜访一位朋友。

choices.text: He is physically unfit for it.
choices.zh: 他的身体状况不适合跑步。

items.stem: Why is the woman's whole family going to the zoo next Saturday?

choices.text: To teach kids about animal protection.
choices.zh: 教孩子们动物保护知识。

choices.text: To learn how popular zoos could be.
choices.zh: 了解动物园能有多受欢迎。

choices.text: To see some rare animals in cages.
choices.zh: 看一些关在笼子里的稀有动物。

choices.text: To give her little nephew a treat.
choices.zh: 给她的小侄子一个惊喜。

items.stem: What do we learn about Dan from the man's description?

choices.text: He enjoys excellent health.
choices.zh: 他身体非常健康。

choices.text: He is keen on extreme sports.
choices.zh: 他热衷于极限运动。

choices.text: He coaches tennis players every week.
choices.zh: 他每周指导网球运动员。

choices.text: He spends most of his time in the gym.
choices.zh: 他大部分时间都在健身房度过。

items.stem: What has the man been doing since last weekend?

choices.text: Tending to his swollen ankle.
choices.zh: 照料他肿胀的脚踝。

choices.text: Concentrating on reading.
choices.zh: 专心阅读。

choices.text: Writing three book reports.
choices.zh: 写三篇读书报告。

choices.text: Planning Christmas celebrations.
choices.zh: 计划圣诞节庆祝活动。

items.stem: What do we learn about the man's book published recently?

choices.text: It is being debated by hundreds of retirees.
choices.zh: 数百名退休人员正在对它进行讨论。

choices.text: It is attracting many people's attention.
choices.zh: 它正在吸引许多人的关注。

choices.text: It partly records his own experience.
choices.zh: 它部分记录了他自己的经历。

choices.text: It argues for postponing retirement.
choices.zh: 它主张推迟退休。

items.stem: What do the articles the woman read recommend?

choices.text: One should foresee a financial crisis.
choices.zh: 人们应该预见到金融危机。

choices.text: One should trust financial planners, figures.
choices.zh: 人们应该相信理财规划师的数据。

choices.text: One should have one million dollars to retire.
choices.zh: 人们应该有一百万美元才能退休。

choices.text: One should start saving as early as possible.
choices.zh: 人们应该尽早开始储蓄。

items.stem: What does the man say about retirement?

choices.text: It doesn't need to be permanent.
choices.zh: 它不必是永久性的。

choices.text: It shouldn't be considered risky.
choices.zh: 它不应该被认为有风险。

choices.text: It helps to reduce travel expenses.
choices.zh: 它有助于减少旅行开支。

choices.text: It is the way to quit a job one hates.
choices.zh: 它是辞去自己讨厌的工作的方式。

items.stem: How does the man say his proposal about retirement can be carried out?

choices.text: By keeping close contact with one's employers.
choices.zh: 通过与雇主保持密切联系。

choices.text: By retiring when one reaches sixty years old.
choices.zh: 通过在年满六十岁时退休。

choices.text: By investing half of one's monthly income.
choices.zh: 通过投资月收入的一半。

choices.text: By following the counsel of financial planners.
choices.zh: 通过遵循理财规划师的建议。

items.stem: What was the finding of the new research from America about consumers' food choices?

choices.text: They tended to be easily anticipated by those belonging to their own race.
choices.zh: 它们往往容易被属于同一种族的人预测。

choices.text: They tended to be arbitrarily judged by individuals of opposing groups.
choices.zh: 它们往往被对立群体的个体任意评判。

choices.text: They were readily shared among members of the same social or racial group.
choices.zh: 它们在同一社会或种族群体的成员之间容易共享。

choices.text: They were influenced by the presence of someone from an outsider group.
choices.zh: 它们受到来自外部群体的某人在场的影响。

items.stem: When did 31 percent of students in the experiment select the healthier option?

choices.text: When they tried to make a positive impression on the researchers.
choices.zh: 当他们试图给研究人员留下积极印象时。

choices.text: When an unknown student from another university was present.
choices.zh: 当一名来自另一所大学的陌生学生在场时。

choices.text: When an experimenter from the research team took notice.
choices.zh: 当研究团队的一名实验人员注意到时。

choices.text: When they were offered both candy and fruit as a snack.
choices.zh: 当他们被提供糖果和水果作为零食时。

items.stem: How could a healthy diet be promoted according to the findings of the new research?

choices.text: By advertising its social benefits.
choices.zh: 通过宣传其社会益处。

choices.text: By teaching consumers diet strategies.
choices.zh: 通过向消费者传授饮食策略。

choices.text: By supporting struggling consumers.
choices.zh: 通过支持处境艰难的消费者。

choices.text: By maintaining its positive image.
choices.zh: 通过维持其正面形象。

items.stem: What does the recent study led by Patricia Pendry aim to examine?

choices.text: The academic and learning issues struggling students encounter.
choices.zh: 处境困难的学生遇到的学业和学习问题。

choices.text: The risk students face due to a history of mental health problems.
choices.zh: 学生因心理健康问题史而面临的风险。

choices.text: The effect of interacting with therapy dogs on students under pressure.
choices.zh: 与治疗犬互动对压力下学生的影响。

choices.text: The work universities are doing to help students succeed academically
choices.zh: 大学为帮助学生在学业上取得成功所做的工作。

items.stem: What did the new study measure in the participants?

choices.text: Their communicative skills.
choices.zh: 他们的沟通技能。

choices.text: Their executive functioning.
choices.zh: 他们的执行功能。

choices.text: Their academic networking.
choices.zh: 他们的学术人际网络。

choices.text: Their leadership capacities.
choices.zh: 他们的领导能力。

items.stem: What does Patricia Pendry think traditional stress management programs may do?

choices.text: Rid students of their anxiety.
choices.zh: 消除学生的焦虑。

choices.text: Add to some students' stress.
choices.zh: 增加一些学生的压力。

choices.text: Contribute little to typical students' success.
choices.zh: 对普通学生的成功贡献甚微。

choices.text: Help students with mental issues pull through.
choices.zh: 帮助有心理问题的学生渡过难关。

items.stem: What do entrepreneurs have to do when taking risks according to the passage?

choices.text: Work hard and plan carefully.
choices.zh: 努力工作并仔细计划。

choices.text: Attempt to succeed at any cost.
choices.zh: 不惜任何代价争取成功。

choices.text: Aim high and expect great results.
choices.zh: 目标远大并期待卓越成果。

choices.text: Remain optimistic even in difficulty.
choices.zh: 即使在困难中也保持乐观。

items.stem: What does the passage say is key to business growth?

choices.text: Regarding failure as something inevitable.
choices.zh: 将失败视为不可避免的事情。

choices.text: Trying out innovative marketing strategies.
choices.zh: 尝试创新的营销策略。

choices.text: Venturing into sectors never explored before.
choices.zh: 冒险进入从未探索过的领域。

choices.text: Being willing to experiment with novel ideas.
choices.zh: 愿意尝试新颖的想法。

items.stem: What are we advised to do when we fail?

choices.text: Expect future success so as to move forward.
choices.zh: 期待未来成功以便继续前进。

choices.text: Learn from our failure and forge ahead.
choices.zh: 从失败中学习并勇往直前。

choices.text: Distinguish between good and bad risks.
choices.zh: 区分好的风险和坏的风险。

choices.text: Examine our strategies and find out weaknesses.
choices.zh: 检查我们的策略并找出弱点。

items.stem: What does it mean to risk-taking businesses when most people tend to avoid risk?

choices.text: Fresher offers.
choices.zh: 更新鲜的机会。

choices.text: Safer operation.
choices.zh: 更安全的运营。

choices.text: More challenges.
choices.zh: 更多挑战。

choices.text: Less competition.
choices.zh: 更少竞争。
